GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2019-10-23T02:12:23Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Is there any way to predaggregate uniqState?
Description: There is no function RunningDifference for uniqState.

But two uniqStates can be summed by +

So RunningDifference can be emulated like this
```
create table z(d Date, z String, u String)
Engine=MergeTree partition by tuple() order by tuple();

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mvz
ENGINE = AggregatingMergeTree order by (z,d) settings index_granularity = 8 
as select d, z,uniqState(u) as us from z group by z,d;

insert into z select today()+1, 'g1' , toString(number) from numbers(1000);
insert into z select today()+2, 'g1' , toString(number+100) from numbers(1000);
insert into z select today()+3, 'g1' , toString(number+200) from numbers(1000);
insert into z select today()+4, 'g1' , toString(number+200) from numbers(1000);
insert into z select today()+5, 'g1' , toString(number+300) from numbers(1000);

select m1, m2 from (
SELECT
        groupArray(d) AS gd,
        arrayMap(x -> toString(gd[x+1])||' - '||toString(gd[x+2]), range(toUInt64(length(gd)-1))) m1,
        groupArray(us) AS gus,
        arrayMap(x -> (arrayReduce('uniqMerge', [gus[x+1]+gus[x+2]]) - arrayReduce('uniqMerge', [gus[x+2]])) , range(toUInt64(length(gd)-1))) m2
          from (select d, us FROM mvz  order by d ) )
    Array Join m1, m2

┌─m1──────────────────────┬──m2─┐
│ 2019-10-24 - 2019-10-25 │ 100 │
│ 2019-10-25 - 2019-10-26 │ 100 │
│ 2019-10-26 - 2019-10-27 │   0 │
│ 2019-10-27 - 2019-10-28 │ 100 │
└─────────────────────────┴─────┘
```

There is only problem that it's working only if state fully aggregated by date.
And there is no function partialUniqMerge to merge by date but leave states.
`select d, partialUniqMerge(us) FROM mvz group by d order by d`

But probably such function exists internally because Distributed gets such data from shards.
